products.description:
Design and troubleshoot Exchange/M365 hybrid mail flow with confidence

In an Exchange/Microsoft 365 hybrid environment, mail flow breaks in ways that are hard to trace — wrong connectors, centralized-transport surprises, and routing loops. This solution maps the hybrid mail-flow architecture end to end: the connector types (inbound/outbound, on-prem↔EXO hybrid, partner) and when to use each, accepted domains and routing, transport rules, centralized mail transport decisions, and a layered mail-flow troubleshooting method (message trace, headers, queues) — so mail routes correctly and issues are diagnosed fast.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the hybrid mail-flow model: connector types and their purpose, accepted domains, routing topologies, centralized transport, and the troubleshooting method.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + hybrid Exchange/AD, admin roles, DNS/MX, EXO PowerShell, pilot mail flow).
  • Implementation Guide — design/validate the connectors, set accepted domains + routing, decide centralized transport, apply transport rules, and run the layered mail-flow diagnostic (message trace → headers → queues) — pilot-first, each connector/rule named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (mail routes correctly inbound/outbound/internal, no loops, trace clean) plus Best Practices for resilient hybrid mail flow.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Hybrid mail flow that routes correctly and is diagnosable — connectors right, routing understood, transport rules controlled, and a repeatable trace-to-root-cause method — no more mystery mail loss.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-MailFlowTraceHelper.ps1 — Scope/diagnostic helper: runs a message trace, pulls trace detail, and parses message headers to show
    • Invoke-MailFlowDiscovery.ps1 — Read-only discovery of Exchange Online / hybrid mail-flow topology: accepted domains (+ type),
    • New-MailFlowHealthReport.ps1 — Read-only mail-flow health report: consolidates accepted domains, connectors, transport rules, and a
    • Set-MailFlowConfiguration.ps1 — Create/adjust mail-flow artifacts (accepted-domain type, partner connectors, transport rule) with a
    • Test-MailFlowValidation.ps1 — Read-only validation of mail-flow correctness: accepted-domain types, connector type/source/TLS, and

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
